name: rwaUSDi
oneLiner: rwaUSDi is Multipli's KYB-gated credit class backed by private credit, structured finance, project finance, asset-backed loans, and market-neutral funds.
collateral: Isolated basket of institutional credit assets: private credit, structured finance, project finance, asset-backed loans, plus market-neutral fund strategies (Nomura, Fasanara, Edge Capital), with periodic NAV and scheduled non-instant redemption.
pegMechanism: NAV-based valuation of underlying RWA basket; KYB-gated 1:1 minting and redemption restricted to verified institutional counterparties

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Multipli defines rwaUSDi as a permissioned institutional-credit layer allocating to private credit, structured finance, project finance, asset-backed lending, and market-neutral funds, with periodic pricing and scheduled rather than instant redemption. That NAV-bearing credit-pool claim maps to rwa-credit-fund rather than a fixed-par fiat reserve or borrower CDP.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Multipli documents rwaUSDi and its unwind/peg module across multiple EVM deployments, with no external bridge protocol resolved. The reviewed route is issuer/protocol-native issuance and redemption mechanics across supported chains.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

Native rwaUSDi on Base: 212-byte EIP-1967 proxy (impl 0x5f0d2ae761a5eed6d7106771db846aa67be153f6), owner() = the same chain-local Safe 0xf25c404c101d40d88b5dcd64b82583dbc918dd25 (read 2026-07-20).

Native rwaUSDi on Arbitrum: same 212-byte proxy and impl 0x2a66bb2da3ad1c854e79307f64b862decd860d4c as Ethereum, owner() = the same chain-local Safe 0xf25c404c101d40d88b5dcd64b82583dbc918dd25 (read 2026-07-20).

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: All four live implementations authorize chain-local Safe 0xf25c404c101d40d88b5dcd64b82583dbc918dd25 for forceTransfer(address,address,uint256) and arbitrary-holder burn(address,uint256), while the shared mint EOA lacks those permissions. Nonzero seizure simulations against actual holders succeeded on Ethereum block 25590408 (hash 0x114ec56a77156d27c6d2d91bf401ca428ffed4aa85f0ff0371b34af67f109052), Base block 48979919 (hash 0x4e8d1eed9b32347b239c53b681c713a167c3f491f0af1b79b7072d0ba3732c83), and Arbitrum block 486632328 (hash 0xc536c0320873e43c1c1d63ee1fdc6cd1b63ccf61cf61ac7c54867bfda503faeb); Monad block 89486097 (hash 0x6d816fae89965dc2323f02e29116adb6550c83b4a8870f8f75d539d10cf1b0be) confirmed selector authorization and a successful Safe call. Current Safe thresholds were Ethereum 3-of-8, Base 3-of-7, Arbitrum 1-of-7, and Monad 2-of-7.

reserves.name: Institutional credit and market-neutral fund basket
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Undisclosed rwaUSDi private-pool borrowers, funds, and strategy counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-07-28: AFI proof payload still reports verifiedTotals totalReserves=1200000000.00 against totalLiabilities=390010160.00 (collateralRatio≈307.6843) with isCollateralized=true and no itemized holdings breakdown in the public proof. Multipli docs independently describe rwaUSDi as a KYB-gated institutional permissioned credit layer for private credit, structured finance, asset-backed lending, project finance, and market-neutral strategies with scheduled redemptions and periodic pricing. Because no current holdings, weights, borrowers, funds, or strategy counterparties are disclosed, the complete envelope remains one unresolved mixed basket; knownUnknownExposurePct=100 matches the 100% basket-needs-split disposition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AFI aggregate solvency proof plus Multipli's documented rwaUSDi eligible-asset envelope; current constituents and weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current asset classes, individual borrowers and funds, constituent weights, credit seniority, maturities, valuation marks, custody shares, strategy exposures, and redemption schedules are not exposed by the reviewed proof.

AFI Protocol (proof-of-reserves attestation layer, not a custodian)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: AFI's proof verifies aggregate rwaUSDi reserves and liabilities but does not identify the custodians, administrators, or prime brokers holding the underlying credit and fund positions; Multipli's documentation names strategy counterparties (e.g., Nomura, Fasanara, Edge Capital) without custody terms.

mintAuthority.summary: A shared zero-code EOA has uncapped direct-mint permission on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and Monad through four chain-local RolesAuthority contracts. Each token and RolesAuthority is also owned by a same-address, no-delay Safe whose cutoff quorum varies by chain: 1-of-7 on Arbitrum, 2-of-7 on Monad, 3-of-8 on Ethereum, and 3-of-7 on Base. Those Safes can mint, replace or extend the minter set, change the authority contract, and immediately upgrade the UUPS tokens.

controls.label: rwaUSDi shared four-chain uncapped minter EOA
controls.capDescription: The token mint(address,uint256) entry point has no global supply ceiling or per-minter allowance. The current EOA does not need to raise a cap before minting an arbitrary amount.
bypassSurfaces: One EOA key can immediately create uncapped rwaUSDi on all four material deployments.
controls.evidence: Complete UserRoleUpdated event scans through the fixed cutoff found this as the sole role-5 holder on each RolesAuthority: Ethereum assignment block 25043270, Base 45684457, Arbitrum 462083810, and Monad 68747935. At Ethereum 25526129, Base 48592766, Arbitrum 483535601, and Monad 87557233, getUserRoles returned bit 5, canCall and token isAuthorized returned true for mint(address,uint256), the address had zero code, and fixed-block mint simulations succeeded. A random address reverted UNAUTHORIZED. The token ABI exposes no supply-cap or allowance entry point.

controls.label: rwaUSDi Arbitrum token and RolesAuthority owner — 1-of-7 Safe
bypassSurfaces: Any one of seven Safe owners can mint without a cap, authorize a new minter, replace the authority contract, or upgrade mint logic with no delay.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 483535601 (hash 0x45f33e882390a11b041d42014a808f848530c07e7c2d1738e8da692c4af5ca14), token owner() and RolesAuthority owner() both returned this Safe. It was Safe 1.4.1 with threshold 1, seven owners, nonce 2, no enabled modules, zero guard and moduleGuard, and fallback handler 0xfd07.... Token mint and upgrade simulations from the Safe succeeded. The ERC-1967 implementation slot held 0x2a66...0d4c; admin and beacon slots were zero; UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION returned 5.0.0.

controls.label: rwaUSDi deployment-wide chain-local Safe upgrade authorities
controls.evidence: This umbrella record exists solely because the current upgradeability schema accepts one controlRef. It does not represent an additional authority or one common quorum: the same Safe address has independent chain-local state and thresholds of 3-of-8 on Ethereum, 3-of-7 on Base, 1-of-7 on Arbitrum, and 2-of-7 on Monad.

sources.label: AFI rwaUSDi current proof of reserves

review.evidence: At the fixed cutoff, all four positive-supply deployments exposed the same mint, Auth, RolesAuthority, and UUPS ABI. The 23,116-byte implementations expose mint(address,uint256), authority(), isAuthorized(address,bytes4), setAuthority(address), and upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes), with no cap or minter-allowance entry point. Fixed-block simulations proved the shared role-5 EOA and each token-owner Safe can mint, while a random address reverts UNAUTHORIZED; only the Safe could execute the current upgrade path. Complete RolesAuthority event scans found one role-5 holder per chain, the same EOA, and the RolesAuthority owner is each chain-local Safe. Exact ERC-1967 slots, Safe owner lists, thresholds, module sentinels, guard slots, fallback handlers, and block hashes were checked on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and Monad. External bridge or route semantics remain unresolved in bridgeRouteRisk and are not treated as reviewed by this control audit.
